text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issue Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale_issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'

      - name: Run stale issue closer
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 180
          days-before-close: 180
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'pinned,security,working in progress,to be discussed,feature request'
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 6 months with no activity. It will be closed immediately. If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue. Thank you for your contributions.
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has been open for 6 months with no activity. If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new issue. Thank you for your contributions.
```
